_source: Built-in claude.ai Gmail connector. Input schemas are taken from its tool definitions. Output shapes were observed 2026-10-16 with read-only metadata-view calls (Seb approved). Field names and structure only; the values below are type placeholders, with no mail content.
_notes: Outputs are NOT raw Gmail API resources. They use a flattened message shape (sender, toRecipients, ...) plus viewUrl.

viewUrl format: https://mail.google.com/mail/?authuser=<account email>#all/thread-f:<decimal of hex threadId>[|msg-f:<decimal of hex messageId>]. Drafts use #all?compose=thread-f:<decimal threadId>%2Bmsg-a:<draftId>.

Fields per view (from the tool descriptions): MINIMAL adds subject and snippet. PLAIN_TEXT adds plaintextBody, attachmentIds and attachments. FULL_CONTENT also adds htmlBody. METADATA_ONLY omits subject, snippet and bodies.
Not observed (needs a non-metadata call): the shape of `attachments` items, and of subject, snippet and plaintextBody (assumed to be strings).
Our tools add: account and accountEmail on every item, plus top-level accountErrors[] and nextCursor (which replaces nextPageToken). resultCountEstimate is summed across accounts.
create_draft: Draft with id, threadId and viewUrl (from the tool description; not observed, since creating is a write)
label_and_spam_tools: Not observed (they are writes). Ask Seb before assuming a shape beyond the modified Message.
